title: Business English Conversation 47:  Meeting the New Client
content: 1. You must be...: a grammar point used to draw a conclusion about a person based off of some evidence - Your flight arrived late last night. You must be tired. - You haven't eaten all day. You must be hungry. 2. to be the head of something: to be the leader of something - He is the head of marketing in our company. - She is the head of this project. 3. to work closely together: to work together on many things and with great cooperation - We worked closely together on this project. - We have worked closely together for 20 years. So, we know everything about each other.
